name: Normalize DWI data
summary: Normalises DWI intensities so the white matter b0 signal equals a set value, with MRtrix3 dwinormalise individual using an FA > 0.5 white matter mask.
description: Builds a brain mask (dwi2mask) and a white matter mask (FA > 0.5 from dwi2tensor), then runs dwinormalise individual with the chosen intensity and percentile, and exports the DWI with its gradients. Use it before comparing DWI intensities across subjects or sessions.

inputs.description: DWI image with bvecs and bvals (sbref files are passed along but not used).

outputs.description: Intensity-normalised DWI with bvecs and bvals exported by MRtrix3.

parameters.description: The value to which the mode value intensity normalization will normalize the white matter intensity.
Percentile of the white matter b0 intensities matched to nval (dwinormalise -percentile).

failure_modes.fix: Check that bvecs and bvals match the DWI.
